from pathlib import Path
import datetime, hashlib, json, os, shutil, signal, subprocess, time

scratch=Path('_scratch/mimo-review')
evidence=Path('docs/plans/2026-09-25-mimo-session-resilience_evidence/2026-10-27-review-fixes')
profile=Path('/tmp/aio-lt-queue-71493f81')
assert not profile.exists(), 'Profile already exists; ownership must be checked'
source=Path.home()/'Library/Application Support/harness/mimo-usage-sessions/legacy.bin'
assert source.is_file(), 'Encrypted saved session unavailable'
target=profile/'mimo-usage-sessions/legacy.bin'
target.parent.mkdir(parents=True,mode=0o700)
shutil.copy2(source,target)
os.chmod(target,0o600)
def record(event,**data):
    with (evidence/'runtime-receipts.jsonl').open('a') as f:
        f.write(json.dumps(dict(at=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),event=event,**data))+'\n')
record('encrypted-session-copied',plaintextExported=False)
env=dict(os.environ,AIO_DEV_USER_DATA_PATH=str(profile),PORT='4579',NODE_ENV='development')
env.pop('ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE',None)
env['PATH']=str(Path.home()/'.nvm/versions/node/v24.22.1/bin')+os.pathsep+env['PATH']
children=[]
try:
    commands=[['node',str(scratch/'server.cjs')],['node_modules/electron/dist/Electron.app/Contents/MacOS/Electron','--no-sandbox','--js-flags=--max-old-space-size=8192','--inspect=127.0.0.1:9823','.','--remote-debugging-port=9822']]
    for i,command in enumerate(commands):
        log=(scratch/f'runtime-{i}.log').open('w')
        child=subprocess.Popen(command,env=env,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,start_new_session=True)
        children.append((child,log))
        record('started',pid=child.pid,command=command)
        time.sleep(2)
    for _ in range(1800):
        if (scratch/'stop').exists() or any(c.poll() is not None for c,_ in children):break
        time.sleep(1)
finally:
    for child,log in reversed(children):
        if child.poll() is None:
            os.killpg(child.pid,signal.SIGTERM)
            try:child.wait(timeout=20)
            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                os.killpg(child.pid,signal.SIGKILL)
                child.wait(timeout=10)
        record('stopped',pid=child.pid,exitCode=child.returncode)
        log.close()

from pathlib import Path
import datetime, json, os, subprocess, sys, time

evidence = Path('docs/plans/2026-09-25-mimo-session-resilience_evidence/2026-10-27-review-fixes')
evidence.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
name, *command = sys.argv[1:]
env = dict(os.environ)
env['PATH'] = str(Path.home()/'.nvm/versions/node/v24.22.1/bin') + os.pathsep + env['PATH']
env.update(AIO_TEST_SUMMARY='0', AIO_TEST_NO_CACHE='1', AIO_TEST_MAX_FORKS='1')
env.update(npm_config_cache=str(Path('_scratch/mimo-review/npm-cache').resolve()), ELECTRON_CACHE=str(Path('_scratch/mimo-review/electron-cache').resolve()), npm_config_devdir=str(Path('_scratch/mimo-review/native-cache').resolve()))
start = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
log = evidence / (name + '-output.txt')
with log.open('w') as stream:
    result = subprocess.run(command, env=env, stdout=stream, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
receipt = dict(startedAt=start, finishedAt=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(), command=command, exitCode=result.returncode, output=log.name)
with (evidence/'command-receipts.jsonl').open('a') as stream:
    stream.write(json.dumps(receipt)+'\n')
print(f'{name}: exit {result.returncode}; output: {log}')
if result.returncode:
    print(log.read_text()[-10000:])
raise SystemExit(result.returncode)
